_: Stylesheets for what an element draws inside its own frame. An element is allowed to be its own thing: these are exempt from the shell's look rules (token-only colour, radius, z-index, shadow; colour literals in shorthands) and from the same-rule contrast check. Correctness and the QNTX-wide axioms (no ellipsis, no unknown properties or values, specificity) still apply. Everything not listed here is the shell: the frame, sidebar, tray, door, drawer, toasts, canvas, and the shared components.
